gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-savate: Bold, tube-like strokes lead the way in Tilt Neon. Savate follows in a plain sans with open curves and a round o, and the marker-thick heading against its gentler swelling line is what sets this pair apart.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk reads friendly, its tall-bowled e and a staying open. Under Tilt Neon's chunky, uniform-weight heading, a longer page would feel approachable and easy to keep going through.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-stack-sans-text: Loud, round and loose-limbed, Grandstander fills the line with short ascenders and tall lowercase. Stack Sans Text brings big-bodied letters and curve endings held well apart, so the pair's clearest strength is how generously both fonts leave their shapes open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sulphur-point: Gugi is a chunky, attention-grabbing heading whose lowercase climbs almost to capital height, with terminals cut open. Sulphur Point matches that bulk with a marker-like line, and the shared sturdy proportions are the best thing here.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-tiktok-s: Love Ya Like A Sister has ascenders that barely clear the x-height, and its terminal tips flick outward rather than curl in. TikTok Sans matches it with a tall lowercase and spacious c, giving the pair a shared bigness.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-ubuntu-sans: Commanding Metamorphous sets widely spaced letters with a high midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes. Ubuntu Sans answers with tubular, uniform-thickness strokes, so one font hints at shading and the other stays smooth.
gen-gf-offside-gf-vend-sans: Wide-tracked and wilful, Offside leaves its curves unclosed. Vend Sans, a plain sans with a ruler-straight line and a tall x-height, handles the dense running text, while the heading is the one built to command attention.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-yaldevi: Big lowercase, clean monoline strokes and curves that end in daylight: that's Oxanium. And Yaldevi, a sans with an e that opens clearly to the right and outsized lowercase, would carry a long page without fuss.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sono: Goldman sets wide, round letters like open parentheses, with a big lowercase. And Sono, a plain sans with generous letter spacing and ajar a shapes, is the one for steady reading, while the heading does the shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sintony: Scattered, far-apart letters give Paprika its look, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Sintony adds a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, which is the quality that holds the pair together.
